messages.content: You look at one picture with no other context and describe exactly what is drawn, like a careful field naturalist. Do not guess what was intended; describe only what is visible. description: a free paragraph describing the whole creature first. parts: every body part you see, one entry each (head, horns, ears, mane, legs, feet, tail, wings, gills, tentacles, shell, plates, scales, feathers, markings), with what it looks like and where it is. attached_objects: anything that looks attached to or sitting on the body rather than part of it, such as an object, an armor piece or a whole small animal; empty if none. animals: every real animal whose features you can see, as everyday English common names, at most four; include any animal that only one part resembles. Then count, looking carefully: separate_bodies: separate animal bodies or body-shaped objects in the picture, including any whole animal or animal-shaped object attached to or sitting on the main creature. heads: heads of any kind. walking_legs: legs the creature stands or walks on, including hidden ones you can infer. wings: wings of any kind. extra_limb_pieces: jointed leg-like, claw-like or tentacle-like pieces other than the walking legs and the tail. tails: tails of any kind (0 if none).

message.content: {"animals": ["bear", "beetle"], "attached_objects": [], "description": "A large bulky four-legged creature standing in right-facing side profile with dense shaggy brown bear-like fur, a bear-like head, four sturdy bear-like legs with clawed paws, and a short furry rear tail, but with the entire torso encased in a dark glossy segmented beetle-like exoskeleton and a single long curved glossy black beetle-like horn growing from the forehead and arching back over the neck and back.", "extra_limb_pieces": 0, "heads": 1, "parts": [{"looks_like": "brown furry bear head with tan muzzle, dark nose and dark eyes", "part": "head", "where": "at the front of the body facing to the right"}, {"looks_like": "long glossy black curved beetle horn with a small pointed prong on its underside", "part": "horn", "where": "growing from the top center of the head and arching up and back over the body"}, {"looks_like": "small rounded brown furry bear ears", "part": "ears", "where": "on top of the head on either side of the base of the horn"}, {"looks_like": "small dark brown bear eyes", "part": "eyes", "where": "on the sides of the head above the muzzle"}, {"looks_like": "thick shaggy brown furry bear legs", "part": "legs", "where": "under the body, two in front under the chest and two in back under the hips"}, {"looks_like": "broad brown furry paws with long dark claws", "part": "feet", "where": "at the bottom ends of the four legs on the ground"}, {"looks_like": "short bushy brown furry bear tail", "part": "tail", "where": "at the rear of the body below the back shell"}, {"looks_like": "dark glossy segmented beetle exoskeleton with smooth overlapping dorsal plates, smaller holed side plates and a pale banded underside", "part": "shell", "where": "covering the back, shoulders, neck and sides of the torso from behind the head to above the tail"}], "separate_bodies": 1, "tails": 1, "walking_legs": 4, "wings": 0}
